subject: ventures/retail-pilot-intel
auditor: agent session (Claude), see run record prompts/runs/ for 2026-11-28 quality/0
professional: a senior retail analytics consultant who installs door counters and joins them to POS data for small independent stores in Italy; first checks: conversion on the store's local trading day, one store at a time, sales net of discounts, synthetic and staff counts excluded, POS timestamps placed on the right day whatever the export format, and honest sales copy

evidence.correctness: Ran the real pipeline (pos cli --file, analytics sync, report) in a scratch dir with the shipped fixture CSV, 16 hand-written door aggregates (47 entries, 12 bounces) and an edge CSV: R-2 milano 2026-08-20T00:30+02:00, R-3 pilot 00:30+02:00 on 08-20, R-4 a 30000 bag with a -3000 discount line. report --date 2026-08-19 gives purchases 4, revenue 130800, conversion 0.0851, revenue/entrant 2783; Python csv.DictReader recompute: baskets 30300+9500+64000+27000 = 130800, 4/47 = 0.0851, 130800/47 = 2782.98 -> 2783. The 00:30 Rome sales land on 08-20 (report 08-20: 1 purchase, 5000) and --tz UTC moves R-3 back to 08-19 (5 purchases). localDayBoundsUtc for Rome 2026-03-29, 2026-10-25 and 2026-08-19 equals Python zoneinfo (23 h, 25 h, 24 h). A milano sale on 08-19 makes the store-less report exit 1 ('rows for 2 stores'), and a USD sale makes the store report exit 1 ('EUR and USD'). Pricing copy recomputed: 149/315 = 0.47, 249/99 = 2.52 -> 'about 0.5 to 2.5'; 50 x 7 x 0.003 = 1.05. New defects: an offset-less closed_at ('2026-08-19T23:30:00') is read in the importing server's zone (TZ=UTC -> 23:30Z, i.e. 01:30 Rome on 08-20; TZ=America/New_York -> 03:30Z); a lowercase or malformed currency ('usd', 'US$') silently becomes EUR and is summed into EUR revenue; in a zone whose clocks change at midnight (America/Havana 2026-03-08) the day starts at 04:00Z instead of zoneinfo's 05:00Z.
evidence.completeness: Prior gaps re-walked. Fixed and working: per-store, local-day reports with 409/exit-1 on mixed stores or currencies; discount lines netted; a receipt with a rejected line dropped whole; refunds reported, not imported; pnpm bootstrap now prints entries 1, purchases 1, revenue 28500, labelled as a pipeline check; README says plainly the docs app is not published. Still not built: the door camera (stub), so conversion needs hand-written aggregate JSON; SKU gap, upsell and experiments are demo data; no hourly buckets; no importer for a commercial door counter's export.
evidence.verification: pnpm test: docs 6, portal 9, edge 4, pos 21, analytics 41 = 81 pass, 0 fail; pnpm run ci passes. Seeded 10 mutants with quality_mutate.py before any fix this session: 7 caught (basket total ignoring quantity, quantity < 0, currency forced to EUR, mixed-currency guard, multi-store guard, refund threshold, store filter OR 1), 3 survived (revenue/entrant and average basket Math.round -> Math.floor, both survivors in the 2026-11-19 audit too; removing the second DST pass in localMidnightUtcMs, which is equivalent for Rome and only matters in midnight-change zones). 4 of the prior audit's 6 survivors are now caught.
evidence.craft: Read report.ts, importer.ts, db.ts, sync-inbox.ts, both CLIs, kpi.ts and the tests. dailySummary now closes its handle in finally and throws a typed ReportScopeError instead of summing what must not be summed; julianday comparisons make offsets in stored strings safe. Remaining: openDb still runs the schema and two ALTERs on every call; syncInbox never closes its handle; a malformed inbox JSON throws out of the sync loop without naming the file (reproduced); latestDayWithActivity hard-codes synthetic = 0 instead of the shared realOnly(options); currency validation silently defaulted on bad input.
evidence.claims: Checked 8 claims. Backed now: README 'Not published' (build.mjs EXCLUDED_SLUGS), portal FunnelPage 'one store, local day ... hourly buckets are not built yet', bootstrap claim, ROI and BusinessPlan 0.5 to 2.5 sales and 1.05 a week (guarded by apps/docs/test/pricing-claims.test.mjs), disclaimer and no-warranty on site/index.html, README Known gaps naming the camera stub and demo-only screens. Not backed: README 'What to build first' still said ranks 1-3 'typically pay back a Core subscription with one extra sale/month at pilot AOV', contradicting the docs and its own Known gaps; site/index.html meta, og and ld+json descriptions and llms.txt call it 'Open-source' with 'SKU gaps, experiments and ROI reporting', and the footer says 'Open source', while LICENSE is all rights reserved and those screens are demo data.
evidence.fitness: The pilot owner's job (yesterday's conversion and revenue per entrant) still cannot be done end to end: there is no door counter ingest, so entries must be hand-written as aggregate JSON. The POS half is now right for a single Rome store with a comma-delimited ISO-timestamp export, but a typical Italian export (semicolon, euro decimals, local times) still imports nothing; local times without an offset were placed by the server's zone until this session's fix. The portal remains a sales demo.
evidence.domain: Matches retail traffic practice now on: conversion = transactions / entrants per store per local trading day, net of in-basket discounts, synthetic data excluded, mixed currencies refused. Departures: later refunds not netted (documented), no staff exclusion or counter-accuracy check against a manual count, no mention on the privacy page of Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4 (union agreement or Ispettorato authorisation for a camera that can see staff; only listed as a gap in the README).

verdict: The 2026-11-19 high defect is closed: on my recompute the Rome trading day, per-store scope and netted discount give 4 purchases, 130800 cents, conversion 0.0851, 2783 per entrant, exactly as Python's csv module and zoneinfo say, and mixed stores or currencies now refuse to sum. Bootstrap, the live-page claim, the portal bucket claim and the ROI arithmetic are fixed. It still misses the bar on claims (the page and llms.txt called an all-rights-reserved prototype 'open-source' with SKU-gap and experiment reporting it does not compute, and the README kept the old payback line) and is not finished: there is no door-counter ingest, so a pilot owner cannot get conversion without hand-written JSON. New this round: offset-less POS times were placed by the server's zone and bad currency codes became EUR. 7 of 10 seeded mutants caught, up from 5 of 11. Scores are before this session's fixes.
